newHolds.reason: Semantic duplicate of ini-2025-01:4, Warburg effect.
Semantic duplicate of aiims-2019-may:17, inspiratory rhythm generation.
Cochlear implantation can be indicated in far-advanced otosclerosis; its blanket exclusion is not accepted.
Naegleria has three forms, but Acanthamoeba and Giardia ordinarily have two; supplied >2 forms key is not accepted.
Multiple options about peripheral/facial nerve grafting and fibrin glue can be true; exclusive supplied key not accepted.
Tuberculous osteomyelitis is a chronic bone infection; the unqualified rare-organism exception is not accepted.
Clear-cell renal carcinoma can metastasise to bone; rare childhood occurrence does not justify cannot.
Vomiting/poor weight gain alone do not sufficiently distinguish reflux from cow-milk-protein allergy in the stated choices.
Platelet count and skin bleeding alone do not establish that a child requires IVIG; important bleeding/severity context is absent.
Unconjugated bilirubin, late onset and beta-glucuronidase can all describe breast-milk jaundice; supplied single key is not exclusive.
Magnesium sulphate is not given to prevent placental abruption; supplied combination includes this unsupported use.
Z-plasty is both a scar-lengthening technique and a local transposition flap; choices overlap.
Choices mix Dukes, Astler-Coller and TNM stage labels; muscularis-propria invasion is not the supplied StageIIa label.
No resistance/ESBL or other severity context establishes meropenem as the universal best initial treatment for the stated complicatedUTI.
P-wave timing concerns presystolic accentuation in sinus rhythm, not the whole mitral stenosis murmur.
Minimum age forMTP is not18: adult consent and guardian consent for minors are different questions.
Blindness definitions depend on presenting/best-corrected acuity and the applicable classification; source does not specify the framework.
